name: Laugh all the way to the bank

meaning.zh:
“赚得盆满钵满” 或 “轻松赚大钱”。

这个短语起源于人们在获得巨大财务奖励或成功时轻松愉快的心情。它通常用来形容某人在某个项目或投资中赚到很多钱，轻而易举地取得了财富。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from the idea of someone being so happy with their earnings or financial success that they can literally laugh all the way to the bank. It is often used to describe someone who has made a substantial amount of money from a deal, investment, or business venture with ease.

lines.en: After selling his startup, he was laughing all the way to the bank.
lines.zh: 出售他的初创公司后，他赚得盆满钵满。

lines.en: They laughed all the way to the bank after their product became a bestseller.
lines.zh: 他们的产品成为畅销书后，他们轻松赚大钱。

lines.en: Investors in that tech company are laughing all the way to the bank now.
lines.zh: 投资那家科技公司的投资者现在赚得盆满钵满。
